title: Why they came / why they revolted
shared_visual_asset: Two-panel contrast card: 'Why they came' (religious freedom, pilgrim hat icon) vs. 'Why they revolted' (taxation without representation, dollar/tax icon).
merge_rationale: Structural symmetry, not confusability — both are 'reason' facts about the same broader colonial story, one about arrival and one about later independence. Discovered after both facts were already independently curated as separate icon_plain cards; the pairing was recognized afterward, not planned in advance. Confirms clustering can happen retroactively as a byproduct of curation, not only as an upfront design step.
